findings.text: follow-on: the two numerics arms land only as byte-identical JSON of result hex with no revision or module-path stamp and no retained log, so a base arm that read the head tree and compared it against itself is indistinguishable from a genuine bit-identical result - the exact hazard the reviewed manifest records under retry_failures.
follow-on: tests.guards_base claims four guards fail at base, but repro-base.log ran with -x and stops after the first failure, so the log evidences one failing guard and not four.
